detail_text: ***ONLY SEAPORT SMALL BUSINESS MAC HOLDERS ARE ELIGIBLE FOR AWARD UNDER THIS SOLICITATION.*** THIS IS A TOTAL SMALL BUSINESS SET-ASIDE***Request for Proposal N6339426R3101 under the Seaport NxG Multiple Award Contract (MAC), for Integrated Product Support Services (IPSS).
